sloka: न्यासभूता मया पुत्र त्वयि सङ्क्रामिता जरा ।तस्मात्प्रतिग्रहीष्यामि तां जरां मा व्यथां कृथाः ।। ७.५९.११ ॥
transliteration: nyāsabhūtā mayā putra tvayi saṅkrāmitā jarā ।tasmātpratigrahīṣyāmi tāṁ jarāṁ mā vyathāṁ kṛthāḥ ।। 7.59.11 ॥

translations.english: O son, that old age was transferred to you by me as a deposit; therefore, I will take it back, so do not feel distressed.
